annotations.title: Push an order to a CRM

description: Pushes an order's records to a connected CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce, keyed on mydatahub_record_id, as record operations only: nothing is ever sent to the contacts. dry_run defaults to true and reports what would be created, updated or skipped; a live push needs the user's confirmation or an agent key allowed push_to_crm on that connection, or it returns confirmation-required. Free; it needs pushes:write and a connection made in the app. Show the dry run to the user before a live push. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.

confirmation_token.description: The token the approval page on mydatahub.emailmovers.com returns once the signed-in person approves. It is bound to that person (their sub), this spend (the machine quote_id, or the enrichment or push) and an expiry no later than the quote's, and it is redeemable once.

connection_id.description: Format: a CRM connection id: conn_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as conn_01JB3Y2X6Y7Z8A1B2C3D4E5F6G.

dry_run.description: Default true: report what would change without writing. A live push needs approval: a person's confirmation, or an agent key allowed push_to_crm on this connection.

order_id.description: The order whose records to push.

update_existing.description: Update records already in the CRM, matched on mydatahub_record_id. Default true.

name: push_to_crm

CrmPropertyGroup.description: The MyDataHub property group written on every pushed record, so licence expiry and suppression are enforced in the CRM by field flags.

mydatahub_record_id.description: The record id: a Salesforce External ID, a HubSpot unique property, a Pipedrive custom field.

suppression_status.description: Kept current: an objection reaching the record updates it in the CRM.

outputSchema.description: A CRM push or its dry run, such as 4,102 to create and 0 already in your HubSpot.

connection_id.description: Format: a CRM connection id: conn_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as conn_01JB3Y2X6Y7Z8A1B2C3D4E5F6G.

id.description: Format: a CRM push id: psh_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as psh_01JB4NC3W2X6Y7Z8A1B2C3D4E5.

order_id.description: Format: an order id: ord_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as ord_01JB4N9S3W2X6Y7Z8A1B2C3D4E.

property_group.description: The MyDataHub property group written on every record (CrmPropertyGroup).

sample.description: On a dry run: the property group the first record would carry.
